static_traits.name: Liu Kexin
static_traits.social_status: 与家人关系亲密，获得支持，但对讨论Self-doubt感到not安
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；not yet接受过心理治疗；既往without类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述经历与想法，配合度较好，语气中包含Self-doubt

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信“成为一名出色的Dancer”是我唯一擅长的事情，这种信念让我在尝试其他兴趣或skill时产生局限感与Self-doubt，并伤害我的自尊与探索新事物的信心。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望not再被这一限制性信念束缚，能够探索并发展舞蹈之外的兴趣与skill，改变心态、提升自信与动力。
growth_experiences: 在High school时期因拼写能力Being criticized，在当时中等强度的压力下逐渐形成“除了跳舞外我一without所长”的自我信念；该信念自High school起持续存在，逐步影响自尊与信心，使她在探索舞蹈之外的才能或skill时感到受限并倾向于放弃。

core_beliefs: 在其他领域I am destined to fail

special_situations.event: High school时期因拼写能力Being criticized
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在学业或语言能力上表现not佳，就说明我在舞蹈之外have not价值或能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-binds self-worth to dance performance, reducing attempts in other areas
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 除了跳舞，我在其他方面都not行

special_situations.event: 去年参与绘画课程尝试新skill
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能很快做到出色，就证明我not适合该领域
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: To avoid failure or embarrassment, quickly gives up new activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远也学not好绘画，继续下去只是浪费时间

special_situations.event: 与家人讨论Self-doubt时，家人多以“你跳舞很厉害”来安慰
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人只认可我的舞蹈，就表示我在其他方面have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与家人深入讨论自身局限，Reinforcement对舞蹈的单一认同
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只会看到我会跳舞，其他事情我做not好

special_situations.event: 尝试探索舞蹈之外的职业或skill
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若达not到高标准就等同失败，证明我只适合跳舞
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces involvement and withdraws early to avoid facing possible failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我只会跳舞，尝试其他事情have not意义

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见与认可为一个多面而有能力的人，能够Freedom探索并被接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被批评，担心被视为“除了跳舞一without是处”而感到羞愧
defense_goal: 通过将自我价值绑定于舞蹈并回避新领域来降低被negate的风险、维持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: Confined to a self of a single talent, a self prone to failure in non-dance fields
object_relations.object_representation: 好意但not理解的安慰者（家人）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to try new activities or proposed an action plan to explore beyond dance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously treats challenges as having to 'perform perfectly' immediately, otherwise it is failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以“这只是浪费时间”“我not适合”等理由婉拒或搪塞，语气理性、情感强度低，避免进一步讨论细节。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当想到与家人讨论Self-doubt或寻求理解时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the family will think they are 'overthinking / being silly', and will only emphasize dance results while ignoring the real distress
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 预设负面反应而选择回避或Displacement话题，语气犹疑、减少自我披露。

manifestations: Uses self-limiting beliefs to fix identity as 'only dance has value'
Avoids trying new things, reduces choices and possibilities
在尝试新事物时感到“have not意义”“只是浪费时间”
Finds it hard to get excited about activities other than dance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将High school时期对拼写的批评not yet经消化地内化为全球性的自我评价
形成并维持“除了跳舞我一without所长”的信念

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When trying new activities, frequently self-blames (such as 'just a waste of time')
Worries too much about failure, gives up new activities too early

positive_force: Family support resources are good (family care and encouragement)
Performs excellently in dance, showing perseverance and training ability
Has proactively tried new activities (such as painting), showing willingness to explore
Willing to seek help and start counseling
negative_force: 核心限制性信念“除了跳舞外我都not行”
Fear of failure and perfectionistic tendencies lead to giving up early
心理过滤与negate正面倾向强，易Self-denial
Biased toward external approval; hard to evaluate his own ability internally

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or quickly gives up new activities other than dance
antecedent: 尝试新skill或探索其他职业时
回想High school时期因拼写Being criticized的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: High school时期受批评后形成的过度概括性信念与对失败的Fear，伴随对自身能力的低估
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible failure and shame, maintaining self-consistency and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Decreased drive、探索受限，Career development受阻
